chunks: Allah is sufficient, and sufficient is His Messenger.
And sufficient is death as a deterrent for those who go to excess.
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Kafallahu wa kafa rasuluhu' mean in Shia theology?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq juxtaposes these verses to highlight the transition from the Prophetic era to the Imamate, emphasizing that just as Allah restrained the Israelites through death, He preserves the community through the infallible Imams. This pairing underscores the concept of divine sufficiency (kifayah) and serves as a theological basis for the authority of the Ahl al-Bayt in guiding the Ummah after the Prophet.
